title: The absolute worst
text:
It’s supposed to be 5-7 items, mostly full sized.
I got 4. One was a chapstick like lip balm. An ugly highlighter, a red lip pencil and a tiny red twisty lip brush thing. No deluxe items, no reason to get the premium size.
The topper…I got the May “box” in late July, to late to cancel this waste of money so I’ll be getting another one that currently shows “shipped” but isn’t due for more than a month.
label: negative
